cds.title: Sam Houston State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; page footers still read 2024-2025, data are the fall 2025 class)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 first-years); residency rows sum to the totals (admit rate 93.7%; international 33 of 43 admitted). The CDS prints 49 international first-years enrolled, more than the 33 admitted, so the enrolled-by-residency row is not reliable and is not used. No waitlist; rolling admission, no early decision or early action. C9 prints 92% SAT / 11% ACT submitters next to counts of 1,523 / 182 that do not match those percentages, so pct_submit_sat/act are left null. C11/C12 (high school GPA) were left blank, so GPA fields are omitted. Class rank (C10, 84% reporting): top tenth 11%, top quarter 34%. Undergraduate enrollment 17,822 is B1 total undergraduates; international 151 is the B2 degree-seeking nonresident count. Student-faculty ratio 21:1 is CDS I-2 (IPEDS College Navigator shows 19:1).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, 2026-27): in-state tuition $7,320, nonresident tuition $19,470, required fees $4,050 (a comment in the CDS says required fees are included in the total tuition, so the fee line may overlap; confirm with the bursar), on-campus food and housing $11,984 (housing $6,658 + meal plan $5,500). G5: books $1,380, transportation $2,004, other $1,792 (other_usd = transportation + other). Per-credit-hour: $244 resident, $654 nonresident. H6: 59 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $17,724 (total $1,045,721).
